name: io.github.covenantx402/covenant
title: COVENANT
description: Discover x402 paid APIs, keep secrets in a vault, pay in USDG on Robinhood Chain, with spend caps.

environmentVariables.name: COVENANT_WALLET_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a chmod-600 file with a disposable wallet private key. Enables the spending tools. Optional.

environmentVariables.name: COVENANT_MAX_PAYMENT_USDG
environmentVariables.description: Hard ceiling per payment in USDG (default 0.05).

environmentVariables.name: COVENANT_SESSION_BUDGET_USDG
environmentVariables.description: Total this server process may spend in USDG (default 0.10).
